copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 它帮你在 Cursor 上装好 claude-mem:启动本地 worker 或连到远程 worker,并配好 MCP 记忆服务与观察者的推理来源。

把观察者改成主机登录模式(--provider host)

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem on Cursor: starts a local worker or points to a remote one, and wires up the MCP memory server plus the observer's inference source.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor, choosing a local or remote worker and a host-login or cmem.ai inference observer.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor with the default local worker
Switch the observer to local host-login (--provider host)
say_en.note: Uses the loopback shim on port 37778

say_en.text: Use a remote worker at https://YOUR_HOST
